message:
Memoize `MacroReflection#klass` for self-referential associations

`_klass` memoizes the resolved class with `@klass ||= begin ... end`,
but `return` inside the `begin` block exits the method before the
assignment takes place — so self-referential associations (where the
`demodulize` branch is taken) skip the memoization on every call.

Replace `return` with a local variable so the value flows through the
`begin` block and is properly assigned to `@klass`.
